create_BenchmarkReducer_subclass: create a subclass of BenchmarkReducer implementing join_results, save_results, compute_metrics, save_metrics, and log_metrics abstract methods
run_reduce_pipeline: run the reduce method on a BenchmarkReducer to join results, compute metrics, save and log them
create_JsonDFReducer: create a JsonDFReducer instance with a benchmark name and target data path to compute MAE metrics from JSON results
compute_metrics_forces: compute forces MAE, cosine similarity, and magnitude error metrics using JsonDFReducer compute_metrics with target_data_keys forces
load_targets_json: load target data from a JSON file into a sorted pandas DataFrame using JsonDFReducer load_targets static method
